extension_rules.new_branch: Add a curated lens and explicit membership; fail validation on orphan or duplicate primary membership.
extension_rules.new_evidence: Append versioned source/claim records through the existing ledger; recompute admission, do not overwrite history.
extension_rules.new_module: Declare all eight fields and resolve claims to current admitted records; thematic overlaps are permitted.
extension_rules.unknown: Missing provenance is held, missing method dimensions remain unknown; role cards do not certify method configurations.
extension_rules.validation_scope: Root integrity and bounded organization checks; not an independent semantic or experimental review.
